Declaration of allergens on the finished pack follows the "in formulation" column. The cross-contact column records what else is run on the same dryer train and drives the sanitation and swab programme; it is not a label declaration and must not be read as one. Wheat and sesame appear in the cross-contact column solely because a bakery blend is produced on the same train on Fridays; validated wet clean with ATP and protein swab verification separates the runs.
This statement is issued without a fixed expiry. It is reviewed on the cycle shown above or on any change of formulation, and remains the current statement until superseded. Questions: Supplier Quality mailbox.
